# Data Lakehouse Architecture – Pipeline & Governance

## Overview
This dataset describes a modern data lakehouse architecture following the medallion pattern (Bronze → Silver → Gold). It captures 10 data sources across 5 categories, 3 ingestion modes, 5 medallion-layer datasets per tier, 6 consumption endpoints, 15 governance controls, and transformation summaries per layer.

## Data Source

### architecture_nodes
Each record represents a component in the architecture. Fields: `node_id` (string, unique identifier), `label` (display name), `layer` (one of: source, ingestion, bronze, silver, gold, consumption), `category` (grouping within layer), `daily_volume_gb` (numeric or null for consumption nodes), `format` (data format or technology). 34 nodes total.

### architecture_edges
Directed edges between nodes. Fields: `edge_id` (string), `source` and `target` (node_id references), `volume_gb` (numeric or null), `mode` (streaming | batch | cdc | query), `latency` (descriptive string). 38 edges total.

### governance_controls
Governance policies applied per layer. Fields: `control_id`, `layer` (architecture layer or cross-layer), `control_type`, `tool`, `scope`, `enforcement` (automated | policy-based | manual | scheduled). 15 records.

### transformation_summary
Counts of transformation types per medallion layer. Fields: `layer`, `transformation_type`, `count` (integer), `complexity` (low | medium | high). 12 records across bronze, silver, and gold.

## Data Notes
- Volume figures are illustrative daily averages; actual volumes vary by day.
- Some bronze volumes exceed source totals due to log fan-out and metadata enrichment.
- Consumption-layer nodes have null volume as they represent query-based access.
- Governance controls tagged as "cross-layer" apply to the entire pipeline.

Transformation summary annotations at bottom for medallion layers for t_layer in ["bronze", "silver", "gold"]: layer_transforms = [t for t in transforms if t["layer"] == t_layer] total_count = sum(t["count"] for t in layer_transforms) high_count = sum(t["count"] for t in layer_transforms if t["complexity"] == "high") text = f"{total_count} transforms
({high_count} high complexity)" annotations.append(dict( x=x_positions[t_layer], y=-0.06, xref="paper", yref="paper", text=text, showarrow=False, font=dict(size=9, color="#444", family="Arial"), )) # Governance banner at very bottom gov_cross = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == "cross-layer"] gov_text = " | ".join([f"{g['control_type']} ({g['tool']})" for g in gov_cross]) annotations.append(dict( x=0.5, y=-0.14, xref="paper", yref="paper", text=f"CROSS-LAYER GOVERNANCE: {gov_text}", showarrow=False, font=dict(size=9, color="#555", family="Arial"), align="center", )) # Legend for flow modes legend_items = [ ("Streaming", "rgba(231,76,60,0.7)"), ("Batch", "rgba(46,134,171,0.7)"), ("CDC", "rgba(162,59,114,0.7)"), ("Query", "rgba(27,153,139,0.7)"), ] for i, (label, color) in enumerate(legend_items): annotations.append(dict( x=0.01, y=0.98 - i * 0.04, xref="paper", yref="paper", text=f"\u2588 {label}", showarrow=False, font=dict(size=10, family="Arial"), )) fig.update_layout( title=dict( text="Data Lakehouse Architecture — End-to-End Pipeline Flow
" "Medallion Pattern: Sources → Ingestion → Bronze → Silver → Gold → Consumption | " "Edge width ∝ daily volume (GB)", font=dict(size=16, family="Arial", color="#222"), x=0.5, ), annotations=annotations, font=dict(size=10, family="Arial"), width=1600, height=950, margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=80, b=140), paper_bgcolor="white", plot_bgcolor="white", ) fig.write_image("/app/output/result.png", scale=2, engine="kaleido") print("Done")

ax.set_ylim(0, 14)
ax.axis("off")
fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")

layer_order = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
layer_x = {"source": 1.5, "ingestion": 5.5, "bronze": 9.5, "silver": 13.5, "gold": 17.5, "consumption": 21.5}
layer_colors = {
    "source": "#2E86AB",
    "ingestion": "#7B2D8E",
    "bronze": "#CD7F32",
    "silver": "#708090",
    "gold": "#DAA520",
    "consumption": "#1B998B",
}
layer_bg = {
    "source": "#E8F4F8",
    "ingestion": "#F3E5F5",
    "bronze": "#FFF3E0",
    "silver": "#ECEFF1",
    "gold": "#FFFDE7",
    "consumption": "#E0F2F1",
}
layer_labels = {
    "source": "SOURCES",
    "ingestion": "INGESTION",
    "bronze": "BRONZE",
    "silver": "SILVER",
    "gold": "GOLD",
    "consumption": "CONSUMPTION",
}

layer_nodes = {}
for n in nodes:
    layer_nodes.setdefault(n["layer"], []).append(n)

# Position nodes
node_pos = {}
box_h = 0.65
for layer in layer_order:
    lnodes = layer_nodes.get(layer, [])
    count = len(lnodes)
    total_h = count * box_h + (count - 1) * 0.25
    start_y = 7 + total_h / 2
    for i, n in enumerate(lnodes):
        y = start_y - i * (box_h + 0.25)
        node_pos[n["node_id"]] = (layer_x[layer], y)

# Draw layer background columns
for layer in layer_order:
    x = layer_x[layer]
    bg = FancyBboxPatch((x - 1.4, 1.0), 2.8, 12.2, boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                         facecolor=layer_bg[layer], edgecolor=layer_colors[layer],
                         linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(bg)
    ax.text(x, 13.4, layer_labels[layer], ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", color=layer_colors[layer], family="sans-serif")

# Draw nodes as boxes
for n in nodes:
    x, y = node_pos[n["node_id"]]
    layer = n["layer"]
    color = layer_colors[layer]
    vol = n["daily_volume_gb"]
    vol_str = f"\n{vol} GB/day" if vol else ""
    label = n["label"]

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 1.2, y - box_h / 2), 2.4, box_h,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0.08", facecolor="white",
                           edgecolor=color, linewidth=1.8, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    fontsize = 7.5 if len(label) > 18 else 8
    ax.text(x, y + 0.08, label, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fontsize,
            fontweight="bold", color="#222", family="sans-serif", zorder=4)
    if vol_str:
        ax.text(x, y - 0.17, vol_str.strip(), ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=6.5, color="#666", family="sans-serif", zorder=4)

# Draw edges with volume-proportional width
mode_colors_edge = {
    "streaming": "#E74C3C",
    "batch": "#2E86AB",
    "cdc": "#7B2D8E",
    "query": "#1B998B",
}

max_vol = max(e["volume_gb"] for e in edges if e["volume_gb"])

for e in edges:

    tgt = e["target"]
    if src not in node_pos or tgt not in node_pos:
        continue
    x1, y1 = node_pos[src]
    x2, y2 = node_pos[tgt]

    vol = e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 2
    lw = 0.5 + (vol / max_vol) * 5.5
    color = mode_colors_edge.get(e["mode"], "#999")
    alpha = min(0.25 + (vol / max_vol) * 0.45, 0.7)

    # Bezier curve

    from matplotlib.path import Path
    import matplotlib.patches as mpatches_path

    ax.add_patch(patch)

ax.add_patch(gov_rect)

    layer_gov = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == layer]
    if not layer_gov:
        continue
    x = layer_x[layer]
    texts = [f"• {g['control_type']}" for g in layer_gov]
    gov_str = "\n".join(texts)
    ax.text(x, 1.4, gov_str, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=5.8,

            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", facecolor="#FFF8E1", edgecolor="#DDD",
                      alpha=0.85))

# Transformation summary under medallion layers
for t_layer in ["bronze", "silver", "gold"]:
    layer_t = [t for t in transforms if t["layer"] == t_layer]
    total = sum(t["count"] for t in layer_t)
    high = sum(t["count"] for t in layer_t if t["complexity"] == "high")
    x = layer_x[t_layer]
    ax.text(x, 13.0, f"{total} transforms ({high} high)", ha="center",
            fontsize=7, color=layer_colors[t_layer], family="sans-serif",
            fontweight="bold", zorder=4)

# Legend
legend_items = [
    ("Streaming", "#E74C3C"),
    ("Batch", "#2E86AB"),
    ("CDC", "#7B2D8E"),
    ("Query/On-demand", "#1B998B"),
]
legend_patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=c, label=l, alpha=0.7) for l, c in legend_items]
leg = ax.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 1.0),
                fontsize=8, title="Flow Mode", title_fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9,
                edgecolor="#CCC")

# Title
fig.suptitle("Data Lakehouse Architecture — End-to-End Pipeline Flow",
             fontsize=18, fontweight="bold", color="#222", family="sans-serif", y=0.98)
ax.text(12, 13.85, "Medallion Pattern: Sources → Ingestion → Bronze → Silver → Gold → Consumption  |  Edge width ∝ daily volume (GB)",
        ha="center", fontsize=10, color="#666", family="sans-serif")

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.07, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight",
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none")
print("Done")

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

with open("/app/benchmark/source_data.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

nodes = data["architecture_nodes"]["data"]
edges = data["architecture_edges"]["data"]
governance = data["governance_controls"]["data"]
transforms = data["transformation_summary"]["data"]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(24, 14))
ax.set_xlim(0, 24)
ax.set_ylim(0, 14)
ax.axis("off")
fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")

layer_order = ["source", "ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]
layer_x = {"source": 1.5, "ingestion": 5.5, "bronze": 9.5, "silver": 13.5, "gold": 17.5, "consumption": 21.5}
layer_colors = {
    "source": "#2E86AB",
    "ingestion": "#7B2D8E",
    "bronze": "#CD7F32",
    "silver": "#708090",
    "gold": "#DAA520",
    "consumption": "#1B998B",
}
layer_bg = {
    "source": "#E8F4F8",
    "ingestion": "#F3E5F5",
    "bronze": "#FFF3E0",
    "silver": "#ECEFF1",
    "gold": "#FFFDE7",
    "consumption": "#E0F2F1",
}
layer_labels = {
    "source": "SOURCES",
    "ingestion": "INGESTION",
    "bronze": "BRONZE",
    "silver": "SILVER",
    "gold": "GOLD",
    "consumption": "CONSUMPTION",
}

# Group nodes by layer
layer_nodes = {}
for n in nodes:
    layer_nodes.setdefault(n["layer"], []).append(n)

# Position nodes
node_pos = {}
box_h = 0.65
for layer in layer_order:
    lnodes = layer_nodes.get(layer, [])
    count = len(lnodes)
    total_h = count * box_h + (count - 1) * 0.25
    start_y = 7 + total_h / 2
    for i, n in enumerate(lnodes):
        y = start_y - i * (box_h + 0.25)
        node_pos[n["node_id"]] = (layer_x[layer], y)

# Draw layer background columns
for layer in layer_order:
    x = layer_x[layer]
    bg = FancyBboxPatch((x - 1.4, 1.0), 2.8, 12.2, boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                         facecolor=layer_bg[layer], edgecolor=layer_colors[layer],
                         linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.4, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(bg)
    ax.text(x, 13.4, layer_labels[layer], ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", color=layer_colors[layer], family="sans-serif")

# Draw nodes as boxes
for n in nodes:
    x, y = node_pos[n["node_id"]]
    layer = n["layer"]
    color = layer_colors[layer]
    vol = n["daily_volume_gb"]
    vol_str = f"\n{vol} GB/day" if vol else ""
    label = n["label"]

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 1.2, y - box_h / 2), 2.4, box_h,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0.08", facecolor="white",
                           edgecolor=color, linewidth=1.8, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    fontsize = 7.5 if len(label) > 18 else 8
    ax.text(x, y + 0.08, label, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fontsize,
            fontweight="bold", color="#222", family="sans-serif", zorder=4)
    if vol_str:
        ax.text(x, y - 0.17, vol_str.strip(), ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=6.5, color="#666", family="sans-serif", zorder=4)

# Draw edges with volume-proportional width
mode_colors_edge = {
    "streaming": "#E74C3C",
    "batch": "#2E86AB",
    "cdc": "#7B2D8E",
    "query": "#1B998B",
}

max_vol = max(e["volume_gb"] for e in edges if e["volume_gb"])

for e in edges:
    src = e["source"]
    tgt = e["target"]
    if src not in node_pos or tgt not in node_pos:
        continue
    x1, y1 = node_pos[src]
    x2, y2 = node_pos[tgt]

    vol = e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 2
    lw = 0.5 + (vol / max_vol) * 5.5
    color = mode_colors_edge.get(e["mode"], "#999")
    alpha = min(0.25 + (vol / max_vol) * 0.45, 0.7)

    # Bezier curve
    mid_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
    from matplotlib.path import Path
    import matplotlib.patches as mpatches_path

    verts = [(x1 + 1.2, y1), (mid_x, y1), (mid_x, y2), (x2 - 1.2, y2)]
    codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
    path = Path(verts, codes)
    patch = mpatches_path.PathPatch(path, facecolor="none", edgecolor=color,
                                     lw=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=1,
                                     capstyle="round")
    ax.add_patch(patch)

# Governance banner at bottom
gov_cross = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == "cross-layer"]
gov_rect = FancyBboxPatch((0.3, 0.05), 23.4, 0.85, boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                           facecolor="#FBE9E7", edgecolor="#D35400",
                           linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.8, zorder=5)
ax.add_patch(gov_rect)
ax.text(0.8, 0.55, "CROSS-LAYER GOVERNANCE:", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold",
        color="#D35400", va="center", family="sans-serif", zorder=6)
gov_text = "   |   ".join([f"{g['control_type']} ({g['tool']})" for g in gov_cross])
ax.text(6.2, 0.55, gov_text, fontsize=7.5, color="#555", va="center",
        family="sans-serif", zorder=6)

# Per-layer governance indicators
for layer in ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    layer_gov = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == layer]
    if not layer_gov:
        continue
    x = layer_x[layer]
    texts = [f"• {g['control_type']}" for g in layer_gov]
    gov_str = "\n".join(texts)
    ax.text(x, 1.4, gov_str, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=5.8,
            color="#8B4513", family="sans-serif", style="italic", zorder=4,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", facecolor="#FFF8E1", edgecolor="#DDD",
                      alpha=0.85))

# Transformation summary under medallion layers
for t_layer in ["bronze", "silver", "gold"]:
    layer_t = [t for t in transforms if t["layer"] == t_layer]
    total = sum(t["count"] for t in layer_t)
    high = sum(t["count"] for t in layer_t if t["complexity"] == "high")
    x = layer_x[t_layer]
    ax.text(x, 13.0, f"{total} transforms ({high} high)", ha="center",
            fontsize=7, color=layer_colors[t_layer], family="sans-serif",
            fontweight="bold", zorder=4)

# Legend
legend_items = [
    ("Streaming", "#E74C3C"),
    ("Batch", "#2E86AB"),
    ("CDC", "#7B2D8E"),
    ("Query/On-demand", "#1B998B"),
]
legend_patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=c, label=l, alpha=0.7) for l, c in legend_items]
leg = ax.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 1.0),
                fontsize=8, title="Flow Mode", title_fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9,
                edgecolor="#CCC")

# Title
fig.suptitle("Data Lakehouse Architecture — End-to-End Pipeline Flow",
             fontsize=18, fontweight="bold", color="#222", family="sans-serif", y=0.98)
ax.text(12, 13.85, "Medallion Pattern: Sources → Ingestion → Bronze → Silver → Gold → Consumption  |  Edge width ∝ daily volume (GB)",
        ha="center", fontsize=10, color="#666", family="sans-serif")

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.07, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight",
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none")
print("Done")

    "consumption": "#1B998B",

    "gold": "#FFFDE7",
    "consumption": "#E0F2F1",
}

    "bronze": "BRONZE",
    "silver": "SILVER",
    "gold": "GOLD",
    "consumption": "CONSUMPTION",
}

for n in nodes:
    layer_nodes.setdefault(n["layer"], []).append(n)

box_h = 0.65
for layer in layer_order:
    lnodes = layer_nodes.get(layer, [])
    count = len(lnodes)
    total_h = count * box_h + (count - 1) * 0.25
    start_y = 7 + total_h / 2
    for i, n in enumerate(lnodes):
        y = start_y - i * (box_h + 0.25)
        node_pos[n["node_id"]] = (layer_x[layer], y)

ax.text(6.2, 0.55, gov_text, fontsize=7.5, color="#555", va="center",
        family="sans-serif", zorder=6)

    layer_gov = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == layer]
    if not layer_gov:
        continue
    x = layer_x[layer]
    texts = [f"• {g['control_type']}" for g in layer_gov]

    ("Batch", "#2E86AB"),
    ("CDC", "#7B2D8E"),
    ("Query/On-demand", "#1B998B"),
]
legend_patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=c, label=l, alpha=0.7) for l, c in legend_items]
leg = ax.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 1.0),

                edgecolor="#CCC")

fig.suptitle("Data Lakehouse Architecture — End-to-End Pipeline Flow",

ax.text(12, 13.85, "Medallion Pattern: Sources → Ingestion → Bronze → Silver → Gold → Consumption  |  Edge width ∝ daily volume (GB)",
        ha="center", fontsize=10, color="#666", family="sans-serif")

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.07, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight",
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none")
print("Done")

            fontsize=12, fontweight="bold", color=layer_colors[layer], family="sans-serif")

# Draw nodes as boxes
for n in nodes:
    x, y = node_pos[n["node_id"]]
    layer = n["layer"]
    color = layer_colors[layer]
    vol = n["daily_volume_gb"]
    vol_str = f"\n{vol} GB/day" if vol else ""
    label = n["label"]

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x - 1.2, y - box_h / 2), 2.4, box_h,
                           boxstyle="round,pad=0.08", facecolor="white",
                           edgecolor=color, linewidth=1.8, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

    fontsize = 7.5 if len(label) > 18 else 8
    ax.text(x, y + 0.08, label, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=fontsize,
            fontweight="bold", color="#222", family="sans-serif", zorder=4)
    if vol_str:
        ax.text(x, y - 0.17, vol_str.strip(), ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=6.5, color="#666", family="sans-serif", zorder=4)

# Draw edges with volume-proportional width
mode_colors_edge = {
    "streaming": "#E74C3C",
    "batch": "#2E86AB",
    "cdc": "#7B2D8E",
    "query": "#1B998B",
}

max_vol = max(e["volume_gb"] for e in edges if e["volume_gb"])

for e in edges:
    src = e["source"]
    tgt = e["target"]
    if src not in node_pos or tgt not in node_pos:
        continue
    x1, y1 = node_pos[src]
    x2, y2 = node_pos[tgt]

    vol = e["volume_gb"] if e["volume_gb"] else 2
    lw = 0.5 + (vol / max_vol) * 5.5
    color = mode_colors_edge.get(e["mode"], "#999")
    alpha = min(0.25 + (vol / max_vol) * 0.45, 0.7)

    # Bezier curve
    mid_x = (x1 + x2) / 2
    from matplotlib.path import Path
    import matplotlib.patches as mpatches_path

    verts = [(x1 + 1.2, y1), (mid_x, y1), (mid_x, y2), (x2 - 1.2, y2)]
    codes = [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4, Path.CURVE4]
    path = Path(verts, codes)
    patch = mpatches_path.PathPatch(path, facecolor="none", edgecolor=color,
                                     lw=lw, alpha=alpha, zorder=1,
                                     capstyle="round")
    ax.add_patch(patch)

# Governance banner at bottom
gov_cross = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == "cross-layer"]
gov_rect = FancyBboxPatch((0.3, 0.05), 23.4, 0.85, boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                           facecolor="#FBE9E7", edgecolor="#D35400",
                           linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.8, zorder=5)
ax.add_patch(gov_rect)
ax.text(0.8, 0.55, "CROSS-LAYER GOVERNANCE:", fontsize=9, fontweight="bold",
        color="#D35400", va="center", family="sans-serif", zorder=6)
gov_text = "   |   ".join([f"{g['control_type']} ({g['tool']})" for g in gov_cross])
ax.text(6.2, 0.55, gov_text, fontsize=7.5, color="#555", va="center",
        family="sans-serif", zorder=6)

# Per-layer governance indicators
for layer in ["ingestion", "bronze", "silver", "gold", "consumption"]:
    layer_gov = [g for g in governance if g["layer"] == layer]
    if not layer_gov:
        continue
    x = layer_x[layer]
    texts = [f"• {g['control_type']}" for g in layer_gov]
    gov_str = "\n".join(texts)
    ax.text(x, 1.4, gov_str, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=5.8,
            color="#8B4513", family="sans-serif", style="italic", zorder=4,
            bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.2", facecolor="#FFF8E1", edgecolor="#DDD",
                      alpha=0.85))

# Transformation summary under medallion layers
for t_layer in ["bronze", "silver", "gold"]:
    layer_t = [t for t in transforms if t["layer"] == t_layer]
    total = sum(t["count"] for t in layer_t)
    high = sum(t["count"] for t in layer_t if t["complexity"] == "high")
    x = layer_x[t_layer]
    ax.text(x, 13.0, f"{total} transforms ({high} high)", ha="center",
            fontsize=7, color=layer_colors[t_layer], family="sans-serif",
            fontweight="bold", zorder=4)

# Legend
legend_items = [
    ("Streaming", "#E74C3C"),
    ("Batch", "#2E86AB"),
    ("CDC", "#7B2D8E"),
    ("Query/On-demand", "#1B998B"),
]
legend_patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=c, label=l, alpha=0.7) for l, c in legend_items]
leg = ax.legend(handles=legend_patches, loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 1.0),
                fontsize=8, title="Flow Mode", title_fontsize=9, framealpha=0.9,
                edgecolor="#CCC")

# Title
fig.suptitle("Data Lakehouse Architecture — End-to-End Pipeline Flow",
             fontsize=18, fontweight="bold", color="#222", family="sans-serif", y=0.98)
ax.text(12, 13.85, "Medallion Pattern: Sources → Ingestion → Bronze → Silver → Gold → Consumption  |  Edge width ∝ daily volume (GB)",
        ha="center", fontsize=10, color="#666", family="sans-serif")

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.07, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight",
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none")
print("Done")
